# Third-party notices

Mathlib is used at its pinned revision under Apache 2.0. Selected Tau Ceti
modules are included under their original names, copyright notices and Apache
2.0 licence. See [the source manifest and explanation](third_party/TauCeti/README.md)
and [the licence](third_party/TauCeti/LICENSE).

These public proofs are attributed to their upstream contributors. They are
checked from source, not introduced as trusted mathematical assumptions.

Selected sphere and normal-family modules from Li and Luo's Sullivan
project are retained under their original `NoWanderingDomains` names and
Apache 2.0 notices. See the [source manifest](third_party/NoWanderingDomains/README.md)
and [licence](third_party/NoWanderingDomains/LICENSE). These include Zalcman's
rescaling lemma and its spherical-derivative foundations.
